_source: Extracted 2026-11-16 from eBay's published OpenAPI 3 contracts (developer.ebay.com/api-docs/master/<api>/openapi/3/<api>_oas3.json): sell_inventory_v1, sell_account_v1, sell_fulfillment_v1, sell_metadata_v1, commerce_taxonomy_v1, commerce_identity_v1, commerce_notification_v1, commerce_media_v1_beta. Success (200/201) response schemas only, walked into key paths in the shape dialect of src/shape.ts (root '', arrays '[]'); integer is 'number'; a recursive ref is 'object(recursive)'. Key names and types only. The error body {errors: [...]} is not in these files (the contracts type it inconsistently); see src/ebay/errors.ts.
